**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.**

- **Locations inspected:** § 1 (purpose/scope of engagement, p0003–p0011), § 4 (ownership/licence, p0016–p0022), § 6 (termination), § 7 (general terms including p0040, p0047, p0048), plus document-wide searches for "compete/competitive/competitor", "exclusive/exclusivity/restriction" and "shall not".
- **Result:** Nothing restricts the businesses Clear Capital may operate or the products it may buy, build or license. The preferred element "Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction" is met as drafted.
- **Out-of-scope items noted, not flagged:** p0020's limit on reselling or otherwise using Contractor's own pre-existing materials and administrative records is ordinary licence scope over Vendor IP (and p0021 gives us a perpetual, sublicensable licence over Contractor's Information in the Works for our business operations); p0047 is a mutual one-year employee non-solicit, an employment covenant binding RadialSpark equally rather than a non-compete or field-of-use limit on us.
